answer: A comet passes once an epoch; its pulse cannot be faked. Forty knolls open for a fifteen-minute pass: each claimant takes the pulse from a stranger and hands it on in sixty seconds. One operator holds at most two pulses: ten fakes need five hands, twenty live handoffs. Entry locks 70 POA, +35 per extra identity from one root; ten fakes lock 2,275 POA. A missed pass burns 20; a pulse shown twice burns both bonds. The ledger checks pass times against funding roots: handoffs sharing one root are void; one hand, two pulses, one claim. Fifteen minutes, twenty places: no operator covers them all.
